Positions are replicated on every rank\n// (needed for the all-pairs force evaluation); velocities are only stored for\n// the bodies owned by this rank.\nstruct Bodies {\n    int n = 0;                      // total number of bodies\n    int localStart = 0;             // first body owned by this rank\n    int localCount = 0;             // number of bodies owned by this rank\n    std::vector<double> px, py, pz; // all positions (size n)\n    std::vector<double> vx, vy, vz; // local velocities (size localCount)\n};\n\n// MPI decomposition info (block distribution of bodies over ranks)\nstruct Decomp {\n    int rank = 0;\n    int size = 1;\n    std::vector<int> counts;  // bodies per rank\n    std::vector<int> displs;  // offset of each rank's block\n};\n\nstatic Decomp makeDecomp(int n, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    Decomp d;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(comm, &d.rank);\n    MPI_Comm_size(comm, &d.size);\n    d.counts.resize(d.size);\n    d.displs.resize(d.size);\n    const int base = n / d.size;\n    const int rem = n % d.size;\n    int off = 0;\n    for (int r = 0; r < d.size; ++r) {\n        d.counts[r] = base + (r < rem ? 1 : 0);\n        d.displs[r] = off;\n        off += d.counts[r];\n    }\n    return d;\n}\n\n// Every rank generates the full (deterministic) initial state so that all\n// positions are replicated; each rank keeps only its own velocities.\nvoid randomizeBodies(Bodies& b, const Decomp& d, unsigned int seed = 42) {\n    const int n = b.n;\n    b.px.resize(n);\n    b.py.resize(n);\n    b.pz.resize(n);\n    b.vx.resize(b.localCount);\n    b.vy.resize(b.localCount);\n    b.vz.resize(b.localCount);\n    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        b.px[i] = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        b.py[i] = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        b.pz[i] = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        const double vx = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        const double vy = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        const double vz = 2.0 * (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 1.0;\n        const int li = i - b.localStart;\n        if (li >= 0 && li < b.localCount) {\n            b.vx[li] = vx;\n            b.vy[li] = vy;\n            b.vz[li] = vz;\n        }\n    }\n    (void)d;\n}\n\n// Compute forces on the locally owned bodies from all bodies and update the\n// local velocities. Summation order over j is identical to the serial code.\nvoid computeForces(Bodies& b) {\n    const int n = b.n;\n    const double* __restrict px = b.px.data();\n    const double* __restrict py = b.py.data();\n    const double* __restrict pz = b.pz.data();\n\n    for (int li = 0; li < b.localCount; ++li) {\n        const int i = b.localStart + li;\n        const double xi = px[i], yi = py[i], zi = pz[i];\n        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n\n        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = px[j] - xi;\n            const double dy = py[j] - yi;\n            const double dz = pz[j] - zi;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n\n            Fx += dx * invDist3;\n            Fy += dy * invDist3;\n            Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n\n        b.vx[li] += DT * Fx;\n        b.vy[li] += DT * Fy;\n        b.vz[li] += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\n\n// Advance locally owned positions, then replicate them to all ranks.\nvoid integrateBodies(Bodies& b, const Decomp& d, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    for (int li = 0; li < b.localCount; ++li) {\n        const int i = b.localStart + li;\n        b.px[i] += b.vx[li] * DT;\n        b.py[i] += b.vy[li] * DT;\n        b.pz[i] += b.vz[li] * DT;\n    }\n    MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, b.px.data(), d.counts.data(), d.displs.data(),\n                   MPI_DOUBLE, comm);\n    MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, b.py.data(), d.counts.data(), d.displs.data(),\n                   MPI_DOUBLE, comm);\n    MPI_Allgatherv(MPI_IN_PLACE, 0, MPI_DATATYPE_NULL, b.pz.data(), d.counts.data(), d.displs.data(),\n                   MPI_DOUBLE, comm);\n}\n\n// Total energy (unit masses): kinetic from local velocities, potential from a\n// cyclically distributed share of the i-rows of the pair loop, reduced to rank 0.\ndouble computeTotalEnergy(const Bodies& b, const Decomp& d, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    const int n = b.n;\n    double kinetic = 0.0;\n    for (int li = 0; li < b.localCount; ++li) {\n        kinetic += 0.5 * (b.vx[li] * b.vx[li] + b.vy[li] * b.vy[li] + b.vz[li] * b.vz[li]);\n    }\n\n    const double* __restrict px = b.px.data();\n    const double* __restrict py = b.py.data();\n    const double* __restrict pz = b.pz.data();\n    double potential = 0.0;\n    for (int i = d.rank; i < n; i += d.size) {\n        const double xi = px[i], yi = py[i], zi = pz[i];\n        double rowSum = 0.0;\n        for (int j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = px[j] - xi;\n            const double dy = py[j] - yi;\n            const double dz = pz[j] - zi;\n            const double dist = std::sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING);\n            rowSum -= 1.0 / dist;\n        }\n        potential += rowSum;\n    }\n\n    const double local = kinetic + potential;\n    double total = 0.0;\n    MPI_Reduce(&local, &total, 1, MPI_DOUBLE, MPI_SUM, 0, comm);\n    return total;\n}\n\n// Validate that the (gathered, full) simulation state has finite, reasonable\n// values. Called on rank 0 only.\nbool validateSimulation(const std::vector<double>& bodyData) {\n    const size_t n = bodyData.size() / 6;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        const double* s = &bodyData[i * 6];\n        // Check for NaN or Inf values\n        for (int k = 0; k < 6; ++k) {\n            if (!std::isfinite(s[k])) {\n                printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value in body state\\n\");\n                return false;\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Check for extreme values (bodies shouldn't fly off to infinity)\n        const double maxPos = 1e6;\n        const double maxVel = 1e6;\n        if (std::abs(s[0]) > maxPos || std::abs(s[1]) > maxPos || std::abs(s[2]) > maxPos) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body position exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n        if (std::abs(s[3]) > maxVel || std::abs(s[4]) > maxVel || std::abs(s[5]) > maxVel) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: body velocity exceeds reasonable bounds\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Gather the full interleaved body state (pos.xyz, vel.xyz per body) on rank 0.\nstd::vector<double> gatherBodyState(const Bodies& b, const Decomp& d, MPI_Comm comm) {\n    std::vector<double> allVx, allVy, allVz;\n    if (d.rank == 0) {\n        allVx.resize(b.n);\n        allVy.resize(b.n);\n        allVz.resize(b.n);\n    }\n    MPI_Gatherv(b.vx.data(), b.localCount, MPI_DOUBLE, allVx.data(), d.counts.data(), d.displs.data(),\n                MPI_DOUBLE, 0, comm);\n    MPI_Gatherv(b.vy.data(), b.localCount, MPI_DOUBLE, allVy.data(), d.counts.data(), d.displs.data(),\n                MPI_DOUBLE, 0, comm);\n    MPI_Gatherv(b.vz.data(), b.localCount, MPI_DOUBLE, allVz.data(), d.counts.data(), d.displs.data(),\n                MPI_DOUBLE, 0, comm);\n\n    std::vector<double> bodyData;\n    if (d.rank == 0) {\n        bodyData.reserve(static_cast<size_t>(b.n) * 6);\n        for (int i = 0; i < b.n; ++i) {\n            bodyData.push_back(b.px[i]);\n            bodyData.push_back(b.py[i]);\n            bodyData.push_back(b.pz[i]);\n            bodyData.push_back(allVx[i]);\n            bodyData.push_back(allVy[i]);\n            bodyData.push_back(allVz[i]);\n        }\n    }\n    return bodyData;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Number of bodies (default: 1024)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -s <num>     Number of simulation steps (default: 10)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation (checks energy conservation)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    MPI_Init(&argc, &argv);\n    const MPI_Comm comm = MPI_COMM_WORLD;\n    int rank = 0;\n    MPI_Comm_rank(comm, &rank);\n\n    int numBodies = 1024;\n    int numSteps = 10;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n\n    // Parse command line arguments (argv is identical on all ranks)\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numBodies = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-s\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            numSteps = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) printUsage(argv[0]);\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n                printUsage(argv[0]);\n            }\n            MPI_Finalize();\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    numBodies = std::max(numBodies, 0);\n\n    if (rank == 0) {\n        printf(\"N-Body Simulation\\n\");\n        printf(\"Number of bodies: %d\\n\", numBodies);\n        printf(\"Number of steps: %d\\n\", numSteps);\n        printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    }\n\n    // Decompose and initialize bodies\n    const Decomp decomp = makeDecomp(numBodies, comm);\n    Bodies bodies;\n    bodies.n = numBodies;\n    bodies.localStart = decomp.displs[decomp.rank];\n    bodies.localCount = decomp.counts[decomp.rank];\n    randomizeBodies(bodies, decomp);\n\n    // Run simulation\n    MPI_Barrier(comm);\n    const double start = MPI_Wtime();\n\n    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) {\n        computeForces(bodies);\n        integrateBodies(bodies, decomp, comm);\n    }\n\n    MPI_Barrier(comm);\n    const double end = MPI_Wtime();\n    const long durationMs = static_cast<long>((end - start) * 1000.0);\n\n    if (rank == 0) printf(\"Simulation time: %ld ms\\n\", durationMs);\n\n    // Gather full state on rank 0 (needed for results output and validation)\n    std::vector<double> print_results(bodyData, \"Bodies\");\n    }\n\n    // Validation: check that simulation produces finite, reasonable values\n    int exitCode = 0;\n    if (validate) {\n        if (rank == 0) i < n; ++i) {\n        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            const double dx = bodies[j].pos.x - bodies[i].pos.x;\n            const double dy = bodies[j].pos.y - bodies[i].pos.y;\n            const double dz = bodies[j].pos.z - bodies[i].pos.z;\n            const double distSqr = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz + SOFTENING;\n            const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n            const double invDist3 = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n            Fx += dx * invDist3; Fy += dy * invDist3; Fz += dz * invDist3;\n        }\n        bodies[i].vel.x += DT * Fx; bodies[i].vel.y += DT * Fy; bodies[i].vel.z += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\nvoid integrateBodies(std::vector<Body>& bodies) {\n    for (auto& body : bodies) { body.pos.x += body.vel.x * DT; body.pos.y += body.vel.y * DT; body.pos.z += body.vel.z * DT; }\n}\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    int numBodies = atoi(argv[1]); int numSteps = atoi(argv[2]);\n    std::vector<Body> bodies(numBodies); randomizeBodies(bodies);\n    for (int step = 0; step < numSteps; ++step) { computeForces(bodies); integrateBodies(bodies); }\n    std::vector<double> bodyData;\n    for (const auto& body : bodies) { bodyData.push_back(body.pos.x); {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5-1","id":"msg_011Cfw11vj8FmqgmZj2YJ6yu","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01BjVtV52m92ZrGSspLoCbsR","name":"Bash","input":{"command":"cd /tmp/o && C=/home/llmtest/evals/20261011-092100/nbody_claude-fable-5.1-cc-medium_mpi_r1/common && python3 - <<'EOF'\nsrc = open('mpi.cpp').read()\nold = src[src.index('void computeForces(Bodies& b) {'):src.index('// Advance locally owned positions')]\nnew = '''void computeForces(Bodies& b) {\n    const int n = b.n;\n    const double* __restrict px = b.px.data();\n    const double* __restrict py = b.py.data();\n    const double* __restrict pz = b.pz.data();\n\n    // Block width for the SIMD-friendly phase of the inner loop.\n    constexpr int B = 16;\n\n    for (int li = 0; li < b.localCount; ++li) {\n        const int i = b.localStart + li;\n        const double xi = px[i], yi = py[i], zi = pz[i];\n        double Fx = 0.0, Fy = 0.0, Fz = 0.0;\n\n        for (int j0 = 0; j0 < n; j0 += B) {\n            const int cnt = std::min(B, n - j0);\n            double dxs[B], dys[B], dzs[B], inv3[B];\n\n            // Phase 1: independent per-j work (vectorizable: sqrt/div).\n            for (int k = 0; k < cnt; ++k) {\n                const int j = j0 + k;\n                const double dx = px[j] - xi;\n                const double dy = py[j] - yi;\n                const double dz = pz[j] - zi;\n                const double distSqr = std::fma(dz, dz, std::fma(dx, dx, dy * dy)) + SOFTENING;\n                const double invDist = 1.0 / std::sqrt(distSqr);\n                dxs[k] = dx;\n                dys[k] = dy;\n                dzs[k] = dz;\n                inv3[k] = invDist * invDist * invDist;\n            }\n\n            // Phase 2: sequential fused accumulation (same rounding as the\n            // original scalar loop, in the original j order).\n            for (int k = 0; k < cnt; ++k) {\n                Fx = std::fma(dxs[k], inv3[k], Fx);\n                Fy = std::fma(dys[k], inv3[k], Fy);\n                Fz = std::fma(dzs[k], inv3[k], Fz);\n            }\n        }\n\n        b.vx[li] += DT * Fx;\n        b.vy[li] += DT * Fy;\n        b.vz[li] += DT * Fz;\n    }\n}\n\n'''\nopen('mpi2.cpp','w').write(src.replace(old,new))\nEOF\nfor fl in \"\" \"-ffp-contract=off\"; Each rank owns a contiguous slice and stores only its own velocities. Positions are replicated on every rank, since the all-pairs force needs them all.\n- **Per step:** each rank computes forces for its slice against all bodies, integrates its positions, then one `MPI_Allgatherv` per coordinate refreshes the replicated positions. Communication is O(n) per step versus O(n²/P) compute, so it scales well.\n- **Output and validation:** velocities are gathered to rank 0 only at the end. Rank 0 does the finite/bounds check and all printing. The energy's potential pair loop is distributed cyclically over rows for load balance and reduced to rank 0.\n- **Timing** uses `MPI_Wtime` between barriers and is printed in the same millisecond format.\n\n**Correctness and floating point**\n\nThe per-body results are bitwise identical to the original serial build for every rank count I tested. That required matching the original compiler's fused multiply-add choices, so I disabled implicit contraction with `-ffp-contract=off` and wrote the fused operations explicitly with `std::fma`. The results hash matched the original binary for n = 3, 1000, 1024, and 2048 across 1 to 32 ranks. The reported energy differs only in the last printed digit because the cross-rank sum order differs. Edge cases checked: n smaller than the rank count, n = 0, `-h`, and an unknown option.\n\n**Performance**\n\nThe inner loop is structure-of-arrays with a blocked phase that lets the compiler vectorize sqrt and division.
